stem: Gibberellin is a plant growth hormone that has a role in germination and in stem elongation.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline how gibberellin is involved in activating genes for stem elongation.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Outline the role played by gibberellin in the germination of wheat seeds.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
The length of stem in pea plants is controlled by a single gene. Pea plants can be either tall or short.

A study was carried out to investigate the effect of applying gibberellin to short pea plants. Two groups of short pea seedlings were used, group **P** and group **Q**.

- Group **P** consisted of 20 seedlings to which a paste containing gibberellin had been applied two days after germination.
- Group **Q** consisted of 20 seedlings to which a paste **without** gibberellin had been applied two days after germination.
- The length of stem of the pea plants was recorded at intervals over 20 days.

The results are shown in Fig. 8.1.

parts.text: With reference to Fig. 8.1, describe the results of the investigation **and** compare the growth rate of plants in group **P** and group **Q**.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain the role of the gene controlling stem length in pea plants.
